items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: I think a fella called Frank Lewis was a clarinet player... Well then I played violin with them, with Eagle Band, see.

ctx.x: Do you remember who was in Buddy's band when you saw him?

I might remember a few of those fellas. I think he was Buddy, and the Runs of Stores, Bob Lyons, Cornish was playing trombone. I think Brock Mumford was playing, yes, Brock Mumford was playing guitar, and a fella called Frank Lewis was a clarinet player. And I think Jamesy Phillips up here played the drums. You see when Bowling went crazy, you know, he's the Hart and Jackson. Well Frankie Dewson took the band then. The same fellas that Bowling had, Frankie took them over and called it the Eagle Band, see. He was…
Was he a loud trumpet player? Yeah, oh yeah, he was loud.
